title: Cloud Listing Integration — Conflux Notes (draft)
body:
Purpose and scope:
This doc collects fragmented notes from the Conflux session (2/14), follow-up items from the partner kickoff, and a compact preflight checklist we can hand to publishers and internal SEs. Goal: produce a single-page preflight + copy bank that partner PMs can use to self-certify and accelerate listing time-to-live (TTL).

High-level pressure points observed:
- SKU parity confusion: partners expect 1:1 mapping between their product SKUs and marketplace SKUs; our billing constraints push to bundle/alias patterns. Need a short mapping guideline.
- Trials & entitlements: some publishers require token-based self-serve trials (single-tenant tokens that expire). Need a secure provisioning path and test harness.
- Metadata mismatches: publisher tiles often miss regional compliance flags (e.g., EU DSR, data residency). Add a required metadata checklist.
- Tech integration friction: publishers test on sandbox but production routes differ (routing policy + model fallback). Provide a simple routing sanity test.

Quick checklist (publisher-facing, single page idea):
- Business basics: publisher name, primary contact (email + phone), legal entity name, country of incorporation.
- Offer metadata: short tagline (<= 90 chars), 1-paragraph description (<= 600 chars), 3 key use-cases.
- Tile assets: 1 hero image (1200x600 px), 1 logo (square, 512x512), two thumbnails (360x240). Provide filenames and alt text.
- Technical: API endpoint(s), expected QPS, sample request/response, auth method (API key / OAuth / Marketplace token).
- Billing: SKU mapping table (publisher_sku -> marketplace_sku -> unit_type -> price), trial token policy (duration, renewal), cancellation policy snippet.
- Security & compliance: data residency flag (US/EU/APAC/none), KMS required? (Y/N), SOC2 / ISO attestations (attach certs), export-control note.
- Legal: allowed demo data policy, PII handling statement, redwood IP references.
- Launch readiness: customer success playbook (top 10 onboarding steps), case-study comfort level (yes/no), launch cohort (alpha/beta/general).

Technical preflight tests (runbook):
1) Auth sanity: call /health with marketplace-signed token -> 200 + JSON {"version"} within 250ms for single-model tile.
2) Billing hook: simulate a purchase via sandbox SKU -> confirm webhook reaches subscriber endpoint within 5s and returns 2xx. Record latency.
3) Routing fallback: simulate capacity threshold (we'll use traffic-shaper tool) and verify automatic fallback to variant model returns valid responses and logs model-version used.
4) Telemetry: verify token-level cost telemetry is emitted (span tag: marketplace.offer_id) for 5 sample requests.
5) Data residency enforcement: hit the endpoint from EU region IP, confirm data-retention header equals declared policy.

Copy bank (tile & short-form):
- Tagline options (choose one):
  1) "Low-latency LLM inference for product teams — secure, predictable, economical."
  2) "Ship generative experiences with predictable latency and clear unit economics."
  3) "High-throughput LLM serving with enterprise controls and private deployment options."

- 1-paragraph description (sample):
  "Redwood-powered inference for partners: deliver scalable LLM features (chat, generation, embeddings) backed by production-grade SLAs, per-token cost visibility, and optional private deployment. Works with hosted, dedicated, or customer-managed environments so you can align security and economics to your customers."

- Short bullets for tile (max 4):
  - "Predictable per-token pricing & detailed cost breakdowns"
  - "SLA-backed latency & uptime tiers for production workloads"
  - "Private deployments & VPC connectors for regulated customers"
  - "Automatic batching, caching and quantization suggestions to optimize cost"

Acceptance criteria (internal):
- All required metadata fields present and validated in the portal CSV import.
- Billing mapping completed and test charge succeeds in sandbox.
- Legal confirmed there are no restricted claims in tile copy.
- SE sign-off on end-to-end demo (from provisioning -> sample request -> billing flow).
- Observability hooks configured: traces show marketplace.offer_id, model.version, and token.count.

Open questions / TODOs (workshop backlog):
- Who owns SKU aliasing policy? (Product or Marketplace ops) -> @Miguel to propose policy by 3/10.
- Trial token lifecycle: do we support auto-extend on conversion? Need legal input.
- Regional pricing: do partners need separate listings per region or a single global price with region modifiers?
- Rate-limit tiers: define expected baseline for partner offers (suggested: 10rps free-tier, 200rps enterprise).

Rollout plan suggestion (low friction):
1) Pilot cohort (3 partners) — support with SE deep-dive, 4-week onboarding. Collect failure modes.
2) Cookbook & self-serve page — publish the single-page preflight and a checklist CSV template.
3) Marketplace onboarding automation — small UI to validate tile assets and run preflight tests automatically.
4) GA: open to all publishers with templates and canned SE support hours.

KPIs to measure success (first 90 days):
- Time-to-live (TTL): median days from submission to live (target < 14 days for pilot).
- Failed preflight rate: % listings that fail at least one technical test (target < 20%).
- Billing reconciliation errors: # of mismatched invoices per 100 transactions (target < 1).
- Trial-to-paid conversion for marketplace-onboarded partners (target >= 8%).

Sample CSV template columns (publisher-side):
- publisher_name, publisher_sku, title, short_tagline, long_description, price_usd, region_tags, trial_duration_days, support_email, hero_image_filename, logo_filename, compliance_flags

Notes to self / meeting prep for next sync with Legal & Platform:
- Bring explicit language around "model output liability" — avoid marketable claims like "perfect accuracy".
- Validate that KMS integration instructions are concise; we should include a checklist for keys, rotation windows, and sample IAM policy.
- Confirm whether marketplace tile needs to include a privacy contact for GDPR DSARs.

Slack threads and tickets to follow up on:
- slack:#marketplace-integration thread id pt2U8k9x (question about SKU aliases)
- JIRA-2981 (billing webhook reliability)
- JIRA-3026 (trial token lifecycle)

Appendix: sample minimal onboarding checklist to hand to partner SE (one page):
- Confirm contact & legal info
- Provide asset pack (images + alt text)
- Provide 2 sample credentials for sandbox + test instructions
- Fill CSV template and upload to portal mock page
- Run the 5 preflight tests with SE and attach logs
- Sign off on billing mapping & simulated purchase
- Schedule launch window and support coverage (first 72 hours post-go-live)

End of draft notes. Intent: convert into two deliverables after pilot kickoff: (1) single-page partner preflight PDF, (2) portal validator that runs the five tech checks and returns a pass/fail with logs.

-- Aisha
